Heritage · programme

Ramallah Family Tree

The genealogy of the original Ramallah clans and their descendants, more than 30,000 people. It sits on the Heritage branch (D53). Every member still has a node on it, and a node is never a lineage claim (D30).

Branch
Heritage · A cluster, used for life

AFRP
Shape
other
Built in the Hub
Built

Who it's for

Members; the whole tree is visible to signed-in members, while the living show no dates when signed out. Anyone may propose a change; the committee decides.

The operating year

Continuous: proposals, life events and imports queue to the committee. No annual cycle is stated.

The five rungs

Not stated in the record for this programme. The five rungs are hear, show up, take part, give or serve, and lead (D25).

Who runs it

The Family Tree Committee decides every change; imports, exports and direct edits are audited. Undecided questions go to the Membership Committee.

Money

Not stated in the record.

Hand-offs

On Heritage, with the Preservation Project, the magazine and the bookstore. Joining creates a node; life events flow to the household, the magazine and the heritage layer; the Scholarship reads lineage from it; Preservation items attach to its nodes.

What it needs

From the Federation's strategy
  • Family tree in the app, with correction forms and GEDCOM updates (2020-21 app requirements)
  • Family Tree named a refresh priority (2026)
From the platform
  • JM-027 not built: photo consent held by the subject, not the uploader
  • JM-028 not built: 'How am I related to another member?'
  • Adoption has no decision; an adoptive link is recorded as non-lineage and nothing is inferred
  • Seven journeys route open to the Membership Committee (lineage, spouse and divorce questions)

Open questions

  • Adoption: an adopted child's place on the tree has no decision
  • By-Law 4.1.1's three spouse questions: a same-sex spouse, an unmarried partner, membership through a spouse after a divorce
  • The club attachment of a minor in two households

How its journeys fare

63 journeys: 47 meet · 7 guarded · 7 open · 2 not built · 0 fail
